beats.text: Add a server to a modulo-hashed cluster...
beats.say: What happens when you add a server to a cluster that picks servers using simple modulo hashing?

beats.text: Almost every key moves. Your cache is wiped.
beats.say: Almost every key moves to a different server. Your cache is wiped out, and the database gets hammered.

beats.text: Consistent hashing puts servers and keys on one ring.
beats.say: Consistent hashing places both the servers and the keys on the same ring.

beats.text: A key belongs to the first server clockwise.
beats.say: Each key belongs to the first server it meets going clockwise.

beats.text: Add a server: only a few keys move.
beats.say: Add a new server, and it only takes over a few keys from its neighbor. Everything else stays put.

beats.text: Virtual nodes keep the load even.
beats.say: To balance the load, each server appears many times on the ring, as virtual nodes.

beats.text: Next up: CDNs. Follow for more!
beats.say: Next up, C D Ns. Follow for more system design.
